items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates how 'he' (Cootie Williams) met Sarah Vaughan and mentions her in the context of Earl Hines turning up singers. The interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with Sarah Vaughan themselves.

ctx.x: Well, how he met Sarah Vaughan, my band was playing at the Apollo Theater, and they had Amateur Night, and Sarah Vaughan came on the Amateur Night. And that's how he met Sarah Vaughan.
